projects.title: Meridian Coastal Villa
projects.sub: Oceanfront luxury residence, real-time lighting & material swaps
projects.desc: Experience this modern coastal villa in photorealistic real time. Seamlessly switch between daylight and golden hour, swap stone and hardwood materials, and explore outdoor terraces overlooking the ocean.

projects.title: The Kinetic Timber Pavilion
projects.sub: Organic wooden ribbon roof and natural daylighting analysis
projects.desc: An architectural marvel combining glulam timber arches with organic skylights. Inspect structural load paths, acoustic reflections, and seasonal solar ingress simulations.

projects.title: Aura Horizon Penthouse
projects.sub: Panoramic high-rise living with live day-night cycle
projects.desc: Curved panoramic glazing frames a breathing metropolis. Features full interior lighting controls, interactive automated shading systems, and luxury bespoke furniture configurations.

projects.title: Contemporary Gallery Space 360
projects.sub: Exhibition hall with interactive spatial hotspot navigation
projects.desc: Tour the contemporary art and architecture pavilion in full 360° panorama. Seamlessly jump between high-ceiling gallerias, outdoor sculpture gardens, and private lounges.

projects.title: Atrium Grand Lobby & Plaza
projects.sub: Double-height civic headquarters with indoor botanical biomes
projects.desc: Explore a striking corporate headquarters featuring sculpted wood parametric canopies, marble finishes, and integrated indoor vegetation biomes.

projects.title: Spatial Living & AR Studio
projects.sub: True-to-scale furniture placement and finishes preview
projects.desc: Preview designer chairs, lighting fixtures, and custom cabinetry at 1:1 true physical scale directly overlaid within room environments.

projects.title: Facade Dynamic Light Show
projects.sub: DMX kinetic lighting sequences on tower exterior
projects.desc: Program and trigger exterior architectural facade light shows with synchronized ambient soundtracks.

projects.title: VR Masterplan & District Tour
projects.sub: Full-scale walkable urban district with mixed-use zoning
projects.desc: Immerse clients into an expansive sustainable smart district. Review green transit corridors, commercial plazas, and residential clusters.

projects.title: Nordic Forest Sanctuary
projects.sub: Timber lakehouse nestled into pine forest terrain
projects.desc: Minimalist Scandinavian architecture harmonizing blackened timber, raw granite stone, and geothermal heating systems.

projects.title: Kinetic CGI & Cinematics Reel
projects.sub: Ultra-high resolution architectural visual concepts
projects.desc: A showreel of high-fidelity architectural visualizations, lighting moods, and structural concept art renders.

projects.title: Immersive Room Projection
projects.sub: Cave-style spatial surround projection mapping
projects.desc: Synchronized multi-projector output designed for CAVE environments and curved wrap-around display showrooms.

projects.title: Botanical Conservatory 360
projects.sub: Tropical greenhouse with multi-level canopy walkway
projects.desc: Step inside a climate-controlled botanical dome featuring exotic flora, elevated tree canopy suspension bridges, and misting systems.

projects.title: Solar & Microclimate Studies
projects.sub: Annual daylight exposure and thermodynamic airflow analysis
projects.desc: Calculates seasonal heat gain, glare metrics, and natural cross-ventilation patterns for sustainable building certification.

projects.title: Heritage Restoration 3D
projects.sub: Photogrammetry digital twin of historical facade
projects.desc: Sub-millimeter LiDAR scan and photogrammetric recreation of historic architectural stone reliefs and vaulted arches.

projects.title: Riverstone Wellness Retreat
projects.sub: Biophilic resort interiors with day-to-night ambience
projects.desc: Explore a calm riverside retreat shaped by natural stone, filtered daylight, and restorative landscape views across guest suites and wellness spaces.

projects.title: Urban Nexus Experience Center
projects.sub: A connected mixed-use district presented at city scale
projects.desc: Navigate a high-density urban district with residential, workplace, retail, transit, and public-realm layers presented as one interactive planning story.

heritageProjects.title: Brihadisvara Temple
heritageProjects.sub: The tall vimana rising over the sanctum
heritageProjects.desc: Rajaraja I commissioned this Shiva temple in the early eleventh century. It is part of UNESCO’s Great Living Chola Temples. The complex gives a sense of the scale and ambition of Chola architecture, while worship continues there today.
specs: The tall vimana rising over the sanctum

heritageProjects.title: Shri Ram Mandir
heritageProjects.sub: Carved pillars and the rising temple towers
heritageProjects.desc: The temple is dedicated to Rama. In the Ramayana tradition, Ayodhya is his birthplace. A broad staircase leads to the entrance, beneath a series of carved towers.
specs: Carved pillars and the rising temple towers

heritageProjects.title: Prem Mandir
heritageProjects.desc: Prem Mandir honours Radha and Krishna as well as Rama and Sita. Its white marble and sculpted scenes give visitors a way to encounter stories from Krishna’s life through architecture.

heritageProjects.title: Murudeshwara Temple
heritageProjects.sub: The Shiva statue and Raja Gopuram against the sea
heritageProjects.desc: On Kanduka Hill beside the Arabian Sea, the temple complex brings together a Shiva shrine, a tall entrance tower and a monumental Shiva statue. Local tradition connects the site with the story of the Atma Linga.
specs: The Shiva statue and Raja Gopuram against the sea

heritageProjects.title: Dhanushkodi
heritageProjects.sub: The meeting of road, shore and open water
heritageProjects.desc: At the far end of the Rameswaram peninsula, Dhanushkodi is part of a coastal landscape associated with the Ramayana. The landscape itself is the focus here: a narrow stretch of land framed by water.
specs: The meeting of road, shore and open water

heritageProjects.title: Thiruvalluvar Statue
heritageProjects.sub: The figure and pedestal rising from the offshore rock
heritageProjects.desc: This offshore stone sculpture honours Thiruvalluvar, the Tamil poet and thinker associated with the Tirukkural. Its 133-foot height recalls the 133 chapters of the work.
specs: The figure and pedestal rising from the offshore rock

heritageProjects.title: Statue of Unity
heritageProjects.sub: The scale of the figure against the Narmada valley
heritageProjects.desc: This 182-metre monument in the Narmada River landscape commemorates Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. The aerial view shows how the statue sits within the river valley.
specs: The scale of the figure against the Narmada valley
